The '''assault''' on [[Fort Orrus]] was an attack made on the [[Great Houses of Alderaan|Great]] [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] stronghold of Fort Orrus by the Great [[House of Thul]] during the [[Alderaan Civil War|civil war]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. The Thul ground forces, which included [[Battle droid/Legends|assault droids]], were lead by [[Varus Thul]], and aided by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Serrok]] from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who supported House Thul in the war. The Thul forces decimated the Fort's defenses and killed the majority of the Organa troops garrisoned there, capturing those who survived. Having captured the Fort, the Thul troops, including Varus and Serrok, remained there with their prisoners until an individual aligned with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] attacked and [[Reclamation of Fort Orrus|reclaimed]] Fort Orrus later in the war.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The attack on Fort Orrus was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. The attack was mentioned in the text for the "Reclaiming Ft. Orrus" quest.
